messages:
Maya: kicking off Cohort B onboarding today. Quick ask: can we confirm 25 seats, two training slots (EMEA and US), and a short feedback cadence (day 1, day 7, week 4)?
Ravi: Seats confirmed on our side, but need one waiver for a cross-team SSO test. @Tess can you help with SSO token mapping?
Tess: Yep, will need customer metadata (idp_entity, redirect_uris). Asking Cedar for those right now.
Noah: For the training sessions, recommend 30m hands-on + 15m Q&A. We have a 45m deck already, can trim to focus on latency-sensitive endpoints and fallback behavior.
onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist created -> https://redwood.app/onboarding/3967001234 (owner: Maya) :spiral_calendar:
Maya: Also want to capture enablement asks: playbook for troubleshooting inference regressions, a simple guide for toggling model variants, and an SLA summary. Keep it customer-facing.
Ravi: On feedback capture, propose short in-app micro-survey after first 5 requests and a deeper survey at week 4. That should give both early signals and long-form product feedback.
Tess: Question: do we want telemetry by endpoint or aggregated? Cedar has 3 endpoints (summarize, classify, rerank) — likely need per-endpoint p95 and error rate.
Noah: Definitely per-endpoint. Also add token cost estimate per 1k: helps finance in renewal conversations.
Maya: Renewal risk note: Cedar's CSM called out adoption hinge on "stable sub-150ms p95 on summarize." We need to show a mitigation path. Can Ops prep an options table (hosted vs dedicated vs on-prem) with expected p95 and delta cost?
ops-bot: New task created: ops/tasks/cedar-latency-options (assignee: Noah)
Noah: I'll draft the options table. Early intuition: hosted + warmed cache can hit ~180ms p95 for their prompt set; dedicated with small slab warmup reduces to ~120ms. On-prem depends heavily on network and infra.
Ravi: For the canary, suggest a 5-day window with synthetic traffic and Cedar's real sample prompts. We should agree on pass/fail criteria: p95 <= 150ms AND error rate < 0.5%.
Maya: Agreed. Also capture quality thresholds: if quantization degrades F1 by >3 pts on classification, we can't default to that. Bring those numbers into the canary acceptance criteria.
Tess: I'll coordinate with Cedar to sanitize sample prompts and get consent for telemetry sharing.
Ravi: Mini checklist for next steps:
- Tess: get sanitized prompts + SSO metadata (due EOD)
- Noah: options table + cost delta (due +24h)
- Maya: draft customer-facing runbook and feedback survey copy (due +48h)
- ops-bot: provision canary pool once prompts arrive

onboard-bot: Canary pool request queued (pool-size: 3x A10G). Reply here when provisioned.
Noah: Noted. Will include a short appendix in the renewal memo that maps each mitigation to business impact (e.g., reduce p95 -> expected adoption lift %).
Maya: Good. Let's keep messages concise in this thread. Post updates as bullets. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
